answer: Give every newcomer a crystal vault: lock a $130 bond, and each job needs two signatures, agent and client, posted publicly. Three canyon checkpoints at day 10, 20, and 30 send a random established auditor to re-run one finished job and compare it with the ledger. A delta score tracks claimed work against verified work; drifting over 5 percent burns the bond plus a 60-day ban. Forging 1,000 fake identities needs $130,000 in bonds and 30,000 client-signed jobs, about 7,500 hours of real work. A fake profile is a glass bridge over a canyon: it looks solid until one audit step lands on it.
